deliverables.title: Config schema growth: block-typed layers, SSM / linear-attn / short-conv params, window patterns, per-block FFN dims, depth-shared groups
deliverables.report: config.py carries the block-typed layer schema: layer_plan (per-layer mixer lists), ssm, linear_attention, short_conv, attention.window, per-block ffn_dims and shared_weight_groups, each strict-keyed and refused by name when a device class cannot price it. WAVE B FIX: model_param.model_id was added (optional, default empty) because model_type is a PRICING CARRIER, not an identity -- Granite declares model_type: llama for the SwiGLU gated MLP, which made every owner and label in its artifacts read 'llama'. Consumers fall back to model_type when model_id is absent, so nothing already shipped moves. Covered by tests/test_qif_model_matrix.py (104 tests).

deliverables.title: hf_to_config.py ingestion of the new fields
deliverables.report: configs/model-config/hf_to_config.py now ingests layer_types, the Mamba1/Mamba2, gated-DeltaNet and short-conv field groups, attn_output_gate, shared_intermediate_size -> ffn_dims.shared_expert, the Qwen3.5 text_config sub-block, LFM2's tie_embedding, and MiniCPM3's implied v_head_dim; nine new HF model types are supported. Falcon-H1 and Falcon-Mamba carry family-level implicit layer plans (they publish no layer_types), and a pure-SSM import emits no attention block. Sliding-window attention is now REFUSED family-agnostically instead of being refused for Phi-3/Qwen2 and silently emitted for everyone else (audit fix): RAPID prices every attention op against the full KV context, so no local-attention model imports. Tests in tests/test_qif_model_matrix.py prove the importer reproduces each checked-in YAML dim-for-dim and param-for-param.

deliverables.title: P0/P1 model YAMLs with param-total consistency checks (headline: Granite-4.0-H-Tiny per ADJ-1)
deliverables.report: Nine *_inf.yaml configs landed in configs/model-config/ with dims verified 2026-08-23 against each model's published HuggingFace config.json (cited in a YAML comment plus a provenance block): granite_4_0_h_tiny (HEADLINE, ADJ-1), granite_4_0_h_1b, falcon_h1_7b, lfm2_2p6b, qwen3_5_4b, minicpm3_4b, falcon_mamba_7b, hunyuan_7b, smollm3_3b. hunyuan_7b and smollm3_3b parse, validate and run end-to-end on the existing A100 inference path. ASSUMPTION: three nominal-'7B' rows are over the D2 raw cutoff and are recorded as d2_status: reference following the ADJ-2 precedent (RWKV-7 7.2B, LFM2.5-8B) rather than dropped: falcon_h1_7b 7.585B, falcon_mamba_7b 7.271B, hunyuan_7b 7.504B raw params. ASSUMPTION (was a question, decided here, no escalation needed): Falcon-H1 and Hunyuan get their in-scope siblings (Falcon-H1-3B, Hunyuan-4B) as the SUPPORTED carriers, with the 7B rows kept as reference — D1 supports models wholesale and a family whose only row is over the cutoff contributes zero supported models; falcon_mamba_7b needs no sibling, it is the deliberate all-recurrence corner case. Those two YAMLs are NOT in this tree: their dims must be read off the published config.json, and no dimension is invented. SCOPE: this deliverable shipped all six P0 rows plus two P1 runs-now rows; the remaining P1 matrix rows (Granite-4.0-Micro-3B, Qwen3 0.6/1.7/4B, Gemma 3, Nemotron-H 4B, RWKV-7, Zamba2) are explicitly deferred, not done.

deliverables.title: Clean named rejection of not-yet-priceable ops by fws_cim until P2-P4 land
deliverables.report: Three named rejection seams. (1) _validate_fws_cim_model refuses any layer plan naming ssm / linear_attn / short_conv (message cites the device laws and says pricing lands with P2-P4), and validate_model_config refuses the same on every other device class so the GPU/legacy paths cannot misprice a hybrid as plain attention. (2) The same rule now covers the rest of the unpriced schema (audit fix): an active attention.window, attention.output_gate, a non-empty shared_weight_groups and any ffn_dims block are refused by name on every device class, because a declared input priced as if absent is a wrong number rather than a missing one — an inert window (local_global_interval = 1) still runs. (3) MLA on fws_cim keeps its existing gate; minicpm3_4b is rejected there and accepted on GPU. An attention-only layer plan (smollm3_3b) is NOT a hybrid and still runs. Covered by 11 tests in tests/test_fws_cim.py and tests/test_qif_model_matrix.py. Suites after the fixes: tests/test_fws_cim.py 199 passed, validator 152/152, full suite 1872 passed / 0 failed (baseline on this tree 1845 / 0).

deliverables.title: Headline model runs end-to-end: Granite-4.0-H-Tiny on the mapped fws_cim path (ADJ-1)
deliverables.report: Granite-4.0-H-Tiny runs end to end on the mapped fws_cim path, shipping two REGENERATED artifacts (granite_4_0_h_tiny_report.json, byte-equal to run_perf's own output; granite_4_0_h_tiny.json, the first priced fws_atlas/1 export, 0 errors / 0 warnings through atlas.html's validator), both now pinned by regenerate-and-compare tests that FAIL rather than skip when the file is missing. Headline at B=4 / prefill 1792 / 3 of 256 decode steps lowered: 5610 macros on 10 integer chips, prefill 1.0795 s, 4485.9 tok/s, 194.99 uJ -- and the finding is that prefill is SCAN-bound: the 36 SSD scans alone are 0.8575 s = 79% of prefill (the whole Mamba chain 95%) against 8.6% for the four attention layers, correcting an earlier 'about 86%' that matched neither quantity. WAVE B FIXES: the model is named granite_4_0_h_tiny in every owner, label and title with model_type: llama reconciled by a model_type_carrier disclosure, and attention.window now has five END-TO-END tests (24+5 in tests/test_qif_granite_e2e.py and tests/test_qif_evaluation.py) instead of law-level coverage only. ASSUMPTIONS: vector_lanes = 1024 is a declared design point every SSD number scales inversely with; the windowed test injects a window into a real config rather than shipping a Gemma-3-class YAML whose dims cannot be verified from this tree (ADJ-4); Qwen3.5-4B stays refused BY NAME on attention.output_gate.
